render.stationsManifestPrelude: # cpm22 (slot 206) -- CP/M 2.2 on a Kaypro II, host-native MAME kayproii; cpm22 wave 2026-09-20.

museum.blurb: The A> prompt before DOS: CP/M 2.2 on a Z80 Kaypro II, where drive letters, command-line tools and WordStar were already familiar office computing years before the IBM PC won the market.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME's kayproii driver (bios 149c, board 81-110) runs on the host -- drawshm frames, ctlsock keys through the generated keymap, no audio and no network. Boots straight to the CP/M 2.2 (GMv2.72) A> prompt with a period software directory already staged on the boot floppy; WordStar 3.3 is a second floppy (flop2). Keyboard-only exhibit like apple2e/samcoupe/mpf2 -- the Kaypro II's own keyboard is HLE'd via an Intel 8049 MCU (device kaypro10kbd), not a CPU-scanned matrix the driver owns directly, so KEY_EXCL may not be needed -- MEASURE from the real browser before shipping the type-in demo, per the fleet's MAME-keyboard rule.

reset.mouse: N/A -- keyboard-only exhibit (pointer transport none), no mouse card or port on this machine.
reset.keyboard: MEASURED 2026-09-20 (sandbox smoke stream, stock MAME 0.276 system package, NOT the fleet-pinned 0.289 native binary): a scripted `DIR\n` through MAME's natural-keyboard path (emu.keypost) re-ran the directory listing cleanly from the A> prompt with no dropped characters over a short single-word command. NOT yet proven: sustained/rapid typing, the browser path, or whether MAME_CTL_KEY_EXCL is needed -- the Kaypro II's keyboard is HLE'd via an Intel 8049 MCU (kaypro10kbd device) rather than a CPU-scanned matrix the driver polls directly, so the samcoupe-style EXCL fix may not apply the same way; measure on the fleet-pinned binary before shipping the demo.
reset.fixture: Kaypro II CP/M 2.2 (GMv2.72) boot floppy (TOSEC preservation image, fed to MAME as .td0 -- MAME reads TeleDisk/ImageDisk natively, no raw conversion) -- boots straight to the A> prompt with the disk's own STANDARD PRINTER software directory already visible (ASM/BAUD/DDT/DUMP/ED/LOAD/... utilities, no visitor action needed). WordStar 3.3 (TOSEC .imd) is staged as a second floppy. MEASURED 2026-09-20: cold boot to the A> prompt in ~6 emulated seconds on a stock MAME 0.276 system package smoke run (bios 149c); golden savestate NOT yet captured on the fleet-pinned 0.289 native binary.

notes: scaffolded from apple2gs on 2026-09-20 (--like apple2gs --tuple none,compactA,none,none); the native shape follows samcoupe's (keyboard-only, no pointer, no audio, no network)

cpm22 wave 2026-09-20: driver is `kayproii`, NOT `kaypro2` as the integration seed guessed -- `kaypro2` is only formats/kaypro_dsk.cpp's floppy-format name string. Confirmed against a stock MAME 0.276 system package's -listxml on labhost.

media does not need raw .kay conversion: MAME reads the TOSEC .td0/.imd preservation images directly, and a dsktrans raw conversion of the same TD0 booted to a permanent 'insert diskette' prompt (bad logical sector order) -- see scripts/build-guests/tiles/cpm22.sh.
